levels.1: Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
levels.2: At altitude, boil 3 minutes. Pre-filter through cloth to remove sediment — saves fuel.
levels.3: A rolling boil is overkill for clear water; a bare simmer for 5 minutes does it with less wood.

levels.1: Clear water in a clear bottle, 6 hours of sun. UV does the work. No fire needed.
levels.2: Paint half the bottle black — heats faster, kills more. Shake first to oxygenate.
levels.3: Works even on cloudy days if you double the time. The System finds this clever.

levels.1: Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
levels.2: Birch bark burns wet. Pine resin is nature's firestarter. Look for fatwood in old stumps.
levels.3: Build a platform first, then a teepee, then a lean-to over it. Fire reflects off a rock wall — doubles the heat.

abilitySynergies.effect: Your fire burns even in downpour. Rain hisses off you.

levels.1: Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
levels.2: Falling pressure = weather coming. Your joints ache? That's a barometer. So are the birds — silent birds mean storm.
levels.3: Mare's tails (high cirrus) 24h before a front. A halo around the moon means rain in 24-48h. You can plan around this.

abilitySynergies.effect: You feel storms 12 hours out. Your storm abilities charge faster before rain.

levels.1: A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
levels.2: The debris hut: ridgepole, ribs, 2 feet of leaves. Survived -40° in testing. Really.
levels.3: Face the opening away from wind, toward morning sun. A fire reflector doubles warmth.

levels.1: Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
levels.2: Gait tells story: walking (alternating), running (grouped), injured (drag marks). Count toes, measure stride.
levels.3: You can tell species, size, speed, and mood from tracks. A nervous animal drags its feet. A confident one doesn't.

abilitySynergies.effect: You read tracks so well it's almost seeing the past. Hunt finds +25%.

levels.1: Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
levels.2: Predators test: they approach, watch, decide. Prey freezes or bolts. Learn which you're looking at.
levels.3: You can read intent — ears, posture, gaze direction. You know before it moves whether it will charge or run.

levels.1: North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
levels.2: The sun is a clock: east at dawn, south at noon (northern hemisphere), west at dusk. Shadows tell time.
levels.3: You can navigate by stars alone, night after night. The System is impressed you still look up.

levels.1: Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
levels.2: Honey is antibacterial. Sugar packs wounds. Yarrow stops bleeding. The old ways work.
levels.3: You can triage: what needs stitches, what needs pressure, what needs to be left alone. You save lives with scraps.

abilitySynergies.effect: Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness.
You take wounds cleanly. No infection risk when you absorb damage.

levels.1: You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
levels.2: Pressure points: brachial, femoral, carotid. You can stop bleeding or drop someone with a thumb.
levels.3: You see bodies as systems. You know exactly how much damage something does and where it lands.

abilitySynergies.effect: You heal like a surgeon with infinite tools. Critical heals.

levels.1: Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
levels.2: You know dosages, preparations, contraindications. This is real medicine, just old.
levels.3: You can treat infections, pain, inflammation, and digestive issues with what's growing nearby.

levels.1: A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
levels.2: Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
levels.3: You read trails like a book and set snares like punctuation. Your traps rarely sit empty.

levels.1: Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
levels.2: Cold smoking (under 90°F) preserves without cooking. Jerky done right lasts months.
levels.3: You can preserve anything: ferment vegetables, salt meat, dry fruit, smoke fish. Nothing rots on your watch.

levels.1: Flint, chert, obsidian — they break with sharp edges. You can make a cutting tool in minutes.
levels.2: Pressure flaking shapes edges precisely. You can make knives, scrapers, and points.
levels.3: Your stone tools rival steel for sharpness. You knap like your ancestors did — because you are.

levels.1: Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
levels.2: Reverse-wrap technique makes rope strong enough to hold weight. Braid for more strength.
levels.3: You can make rope, nets, and bindings from almost any fibrous plant. The village never runs out of string.

levels.1: Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
levels.2: You can tell when someone's lying, scared, or hiding something. It's in the shoulders.
levels.3: You read rooms like books. You know who's allied, who's lying, who's about to break — before they do.

abilitySynergies.effect: You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next.

levels.1: Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
levels.2: You can talk someone down from a full panic attack. Voice low, steady, certain. You are the calm.
levels.3: Groups panic differently than individuals. You can steady a whole room. Leaders are made here.

levels.1: Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
levels.2: Find the interest behind the position. They're not fighting about the thing — they're fighting about respect.
levels.3: You can resolve conflicts that seemed impossible. The village trusts you with its worst moments.

abilitySynergies.effect: Your mediation is almost supernatural. Conflicts dissolve.

levels.1: Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
levels.2: Bounding overwatch: one moves, one covers. Ambushes need kill zones. Retreats need rally points.
levels.3: You think in three dimensions and four moves ahead. Your party fights like a unit, not a mob.

levels.1: Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
levels.2: You see weapons in the environment: choke points, heavy objects, things that burn.
levels.3: You turn the battlefield into an arsenal. The System finds this deeply entertaining.

levels.1: Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
levels.2: You can function through terror. Your hands shake but they work. This is a trained skill.
levels.3: You transmute fear into focus. The more scared you should be, the clearer you think.

levels.1: People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.
levels.2: Rituals matter: shared meals, stories, songs. You're not just feeding bodies.
levels.3: You can hold a group together through the unsurvivable. They follow you because you make it bearable.

levels.1: The System isn't a god. It's an audience with power. That changes how you pray.
levels.2: You understand what it wants: narrative, growth, surprise. You can perform for it deliberately.
levels.3: You've glimpsed the shape of the watchers. They're not cruel. They're just... very, very bored. And you're the show.

levels.1: Marking the dead matters. Even without religion, ritual holds grief.
levels.2: Shared rituals bind groups tighter than shared goals. You create meaning on purpose.
levels.3: Your rituals give people something the System can't televise: genuine sacredness.

levels.1: People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.
levels.2: You can tell how many, how fast, how loaded. You read a group's story from the ground.
levels.3: You can track across rock and stream. Almost nothing moves without you knowing.

levels.1: You've seen the seams. The System isn't seamless — it's stitched. There's something underneath.
levels.2: You understand the integration: how it reads you, what it can't see, where the blind spots are.
levels.3: You know how to be uninteresting on purpose. Invisibility through boredom. The ultimate defense.

levels.1: You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
levels.2: You can spot cache sites by architecture and habit. Every ruin has secrets if you know where to look.
levels.3: You find things others walk past. The old world left supplies for those who know how to ask.
